.SH NAME
fbdevhw \- os-specific submodule for framebuffer device access .SH DESCRIPTION
.B fbdevhw
provides functions for talking to a framebuffer device. It is os-specific. It is a submodule used by other video drivers.

a

.B fbdevhw
module is currently available for linux framebuffer devices. .PP
fbdev(4) is a non-accelerated driver which runs on top of the fbdevhw module. fbdevhw can be used by other drivers too, this is usually activated with `Option UseFBDev"' in the device section. .SH SEE ALSO"
